paragraphs: Lachma. R' Levi bar Lachma — [Rosh Hashanah 29b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.29b.7),[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbi Levi bar Lachma, transmitting in Rabbi Chama bar Chanina’s name about sounding the shofar on Shabbat.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2339&lang=en) also cites this daf under Levi bar Lachma and discusses whether Levi bar Chama may be the same person.
